chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

You say Takbir, then you testify, then you say: 'We are for Allah and to Him we return. Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, Lord of death and life. Send blessings upon Muhammad and his Family. May Allah recompense Muhammad with the best recompense for what he did for his community and for what he conveyed of the messages of his Lord.'

Then you say: 'O Allah, Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, his forelock is in Your hand, he has departed from the world and is in need of Your mercy, and You are free from punishing him. O Allah, we do not know from him except good, and You are more knowing of him. O Allah, if he was a doer of good, increase in his goodness and accept from him; and if he was a doer of evil, forgive his sin and have mercy on him and overlook him by Your mercy.'

O Allah, join him with Your Prophet and establish him with the firm word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter. O Allah, lead us and him along the path of guidance, and guide us and him to Your straight path. O Allah, Your forgiveness, Your forgiveness.
Then you say Takbir a second time and say the like of what you said, until you finish five Takbirs.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific supplications and steps for the Shia funeral prayer (Salat al-Mayyit)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi details the ritual structure of Salat al-Mayyit, emphasizing the five Takbirs and specific supplications that reflect the Shia focus on the Prophet's intercession and the deceased's transition to the Hereafter. It highlights the theological balance between acknowledging human deficiency ('abdaka ibn 'abdika') and divine mercy, serving as a practical guide for communal mourning and spiritual support for the departed.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘You should exclaim Takbeer, then you should testify, then you should be saying, ‘We are from Allahazwj and to Himazwj we are returning. The Praise is for Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the worlds, Lordazwj of the death and the life. Send Blessings upon Muhammadazwj and the Peopleasws of Hisazwj Household. O Allahazwj! Recompense Muhammadsaww with the best of the Recompense due to what hesaww did with hissaww community, and due to what hesaww delivered from the Message of hissaww Lordazwj’.

Then you should be saying, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! (This here is) Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, a son of Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, a son of Your<sup>azwj</sup> maid. His forehead is in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Hands, having vacated from the world and is needy to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy, and You<sup>azwj</sup> are Needless from Punishing him. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! We do not know from him except for goodness and You<sup>azwj</sup> are more Knowing with him. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If he was a good does, so Increase in his good deeds, and Accept from him; and if he was an evil doers, so Forgive his sins for him and be Merciful to him, and Overlook (his faults) from him by Your<sup>azwj</sup> Mercy.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Attach him with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and Affirm him with the firm Words in the life of the world and in the Hereafter. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> by us and by him, the Way of Guidance, and Guide us and him to Your<sup>azwj</sup> Straight Path. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Your<sup>azwj</sup> Forgiveness! Your<sup>azwj</sup> Forgiveness!’
Then exclaim the second Takbeer and you should be saying the like of what you said, until you are free from five Takbeers’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

In Salah (prayer) for a deceased say Takbir (Allah is great beyond description) and the testimony and say, “We are from Allah and to Allah we return. All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds, Lord of death and life. O Allah, I pray to You to grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause. O Allah I pray to You to grant Muhammad the best of rewards for his favors to his followers and for his preaching the message of his Lord.”

Then say, “O Lord, this is Your servant, the son of Your male and a female servant. His forehead is in Your control. He has left this world, he is in need of Your mercy, and You do not need his being punished. O Lord, we do not know about him anything except good; but You know more about him than we know. O Lord, if he is a person of good deeds, increase his good deeds. If he is a person of bad deeds, forgive his sins, grant him mercy, forgive him through your mercy, join him with your Holy prophet, and keep him on the unchangeable word in the worldly life and in the hereafter. O Lord, make us to walk on the path of guidance and guide him and us to the right path. O Lord, grant (us) forgiveness, O Lord grant (us) forgiveness.”
Repeat what you have said after every Takbir (Allah is great beyond description) until you say all five Takbir (Allah is great beyond description).’”
